channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Tehran displays mock installation of Trump behind bars
item.description: An Iranian performer in Tehran’s busy Tajrish Square has impersonated US President Donald Trump behind bars.

item.title: Iran determined to keep uranium amid increased war odds, flurry of meetings
item.description: Tehran had 'nothing new' to tell Washington after latest nuclear proposals reportedly offered by mediators.

item.title: Yemen holds mass funeral for 75 recruits killed in Houthi strike
item.description: A mass funeral has been held in southern Yemen for 75 recruits killed in a Houthi missile strike on a training camp.

item.title: Family of prison officer killed by IRA receives state apology
item.description: Brian Stack was crossing a street in Dublin in 1983 when he was shot in the back of the neck and died 18 months later.

item.title: Swimmer, 65, killed in shark attack off South Africa's east coast
item.description: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was out on her daily morning swim with her club when she was attacked, her family tell the BBC.
